modelo.titulo: Overview of Nature's Sunshine's Chinese system
modelo.texto: Nature's Sunshine's (NSP) Chinese formula system is a commercial, simplified adaptation of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) for Western distributors. Each formula is described according to the Five Elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) and according to whether it addresses a 'stressed constitution' (excess; a 'reducing' formula, e.g. 'wood-reducing', 'earth reducing', 'calm a stressed fire constitution') or a 'weakened constitution' (deficiency; an 'enhancing/tonifying' formula, e.g. 'enhance earth', 'strengthen a weakened wood constitution'). There are also formulas for Qi (Mood Elevator for 'sagging'/stagnant Qi, Trigger Immune for deficient Qi) and for Heat/Dryness (IF-C for excess Yang/Heat, HY-C for Yin deficiency). NSP groups 14 TCM concentrates into two packs: the Chinese Positive Pack (+, 'yang') with Anti-Gas, IF-C, Kidney Activator, Liver Balance, Stress Relief, Mood Elevator and Breathe Activator; and the Chinese Negative Pack (-, 'yin') with Lung Support, Blood Stimulator, HY-C, KB-C, Nervous Fatigue, Spleen Activator and Trigger Immune. When these packs are cross-referenced with NSP's descriptions and with the Tree of Light (Steven Horne) constitutional questionnaire, the seven '+' formulas match the EXCESS categories (excess Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water, excess Yang and sagging Qi) and the seven '-' formulas match the DEFICIENCY categories (deficient Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water, Yin deficiency and deficient Qi). This correspondence is the compiler's synthesis based on the sources; no source found publishes the complete table explicitly. VS-C and Mineral-Chi Tonic do not belong to either pack. Traditional use according to Chinese medicine and NSP distributor literature; this is not a proven medical treatment and does not replace professional advice.

'Positive' (+) = 'yang'. NSP describes the Positive Pack as 'yang-building' / 'Build yang energy with 7 concentrated blends' (current marketing text). However, judging by their content, the '+' formulas are the REDUCING / CLEANSING formulas for excess conditions or a 'stressed constitution': Liver Balance ('wood-reducing', stressed Wood), Anti-Gas ('earth reducing'), Kidney Activator ('water-reducing', 'clear the dampness'), Breathe Activator ('stressed metal constitution', 'ventilate the lungs'), IF-C ('qing re', 'clear the heat'; labeled 'Yang formula' in Canada), Stress Relief ('an shen', 'fire-reducing', 'calm a stressed fire constitution') and Mood Elevator ('jie yu', regulates/releases 'trapped' Qi). Steven Horne classifies most of them as 'Cleansers': Kidney Activator ('Cleanser'), Anti-Gas ('cleansing'), Stress Relief ('cleanser... Reducing action'), IF-C ('cleanses'). The interpretation most consistent with the sources: '+' indicates formulas for yang/excess patterns (Heat, congestion, stagnation, retained Dampness), that is, formulas that reduce or disperse; the marketing phrase 'build yang energy' partly contradicts this reading and is recorded as a discrepancy. In addition, an NSP product sheet for Stress Relief 100 capsules marks it 'Stress Relief (-)', and the one for Mood Elevator calls it 'fire-enhancing' even though it is in the positive pack: further inconsistencies in NSP's own material.

'Negative' (-) = 'yin'. NSP describes the Negative Pack as 'Seven yin-building Chinese formulas' and says it promotes 'yin, or negative energy'; in TCM, Yin represents what cools, moistens and nourishes. Judging by their content, the '-' formulas are TONIFYING / BUILDING formulas for deficiency or a 'weakened constitution': Blood Stimulator ('bu xue', 'strengthen a weakened wood constitution'), Nervous Fatigue ('yang xin', 'fire-enhancing'), Spleen Activator ('wen zhong', 'Enhance Earth', 'supports a weak earth element'), Lung Support ('fu lei', 'weakened metal constitution'), KB-C ('jian gu', 'strengthen the water element', nourishes Kidney Yang), HY-C ('bu yin', nourishes Yin / 'reduce fire and strengthen water') and Trigger Immune ('sheng mai', 'strengthen a weakened energy constitution'). Steven Horne calls them 'Builders' (KB-C: 'Builder - works on weakened Kidneys'; Spleen Activator: 'building'; Nervous Fatigue: 'builder'; Lung Support and Trigger Immune: tonics). Note: 'negative' does not strictly mean 'cold': KB-C nourishes Kidney Yang and Spleen Activator 'warms the center', but both are tonics for deficiency.

modelo.titulo: The Five Elements and the organs
modelo.texto: Correspondences used by NSP/Tree of Light (synthesis): WOOD (Liver/Gallbladder; detoxification, Blood): excess/stressed -> Liver Balance (+, 'tiao he', Wood-reducing); deficient/weakened -> Blood Stimulator (-, 'bu xue', Blood tonic). FIRE (Heart; NSP: governs emotional states, mood and blood circulation): excess/stressed -> Stress Relief (+, 'an shen') and IF-C (+, 'qing re', Heat/acute inflammation); deficient -> Nervous Fatigue (-, 'yang xin', Fire-enhancing). EARTH (Spleen, pancreas, Stomach; digestion): excess -> Anti-Gas (+, 'xiao dao', Earth-reducing); deficient -> Spleen Activator (-, 'wen zhong', Earth-enhancing). METAL (Lungs and Large Intestine): excess/stressed -> Breathe Activator (+, 'xuan fei'); deficient/weakened -> Lung Support (-, 'fu lei'); VS-C is described as 'metal enhancing' (outside the packs). WATER (Kidneys, Bladder, adrenals, bones; NSP: 'reservoir of life'): excess (Dampness/fluid retention) -> Kidney Activator (+, 'qu shi', Water-reducing); deficient -> KB-C (-, 'jian gu'). Cross-cutting categories in the Tree of Light questionnaire: Excess Yang -> IF-C (+); Yin Deficiency -> HY-C (-); sagging/stagnant Qi ('Sagging Qi') -> Mood Elevator (+); deficient Qi -> Trigger Immune (-). Mineral-Chi Tonic is described as balancing the 12 meridians and energizing the five constitutional types. The formula-to-category assignment for the questionnaire is the compiler's deduction based on descriptions from NSP and Steven Horne; the questionnaire itself does not name products.

modelo.titulo: How to choose between the positive and the negative formula
modelo.texto: 1) Determine which element is most out of balance and whether it is in excess ('stressed') or deficiency ('weakened'). Tree of Light offers the questionnaire 'What is Your Chinese Constitutional Type?': 14 lists of 14 symptoms (Wood/Fire/Earth/Metal/Water in excess and in deficiency, Excess Yang, Yin Deficiency, sagging Qi, deficient Qi), each symptom scored 0 (never), 1 (past/mild), 2 (current/moderate) or 3 (severe); the result shows the element with the highest total score and whether excess or deficiency predominates. The lists include tongue signs (red tip, thick coating, teeth marks, pale tongue, dry red tongue, trembling tongue). 2) If excess/acute signs predominate (congestion, heat, gas, fluid retention, tension, irritability), choose the element's '+' formula (reducing/cleansing); if deficiency/chronic signs predominate (weakness, paleness, fatigue, dryness, exhaustion), choose the '-' formula (tonifying/building). Examples from Steven Horne: digestion with gas, foul-smelling belching and acute indigestion -> Anti-Gas (cleansing); a pale, thin person who cannot gain weight -> Spleen Activator (building); fluid retention -> Kidney Activator ('Cleanser'); weak kidneys with low back pain, weak knees/ankles, osteoporosis -> KB-C ('Builder'); acute stress -> Stress Relief; adrenal exhaustion/'burnout' -> Nervous Fatigue; acute inflammation and heat -> IF-C ('cleanses'); chronic inflammation/low-grade viruses -> VS-C ('builds'). Horne notes that children tend to have more acute 'stressed' conditions than chronic ones. 3) Horne's general principle ('Yin and Yang in Diagnosis'): assess hot vs. cold and damp vs. dry before choosing remedies, and use remedies with energetics opposite to the imbalance. 4) The complete packs (+ or -) are taken as 1 capsule from each bottle daily for 30 days, for three consecutive months (NSP directions). No NSP sources were found that teach pulse diagnosis for choosing these formulas. The 'TCM' concentrates are equivalent to about 5 capsules of the regular version (according to the distributor Four Winds/webnat).

Nature's Sunshine Products (Utah, USA) has marketed Chinese formulas since the mid-1980s. NSP states that it has worked with the same herb supplier in China for more than 35 years. VS-C was developed in the mid-1980s with Dr. Wenwei Xie, a TCM physician from Beijing who came to the US on a research project on Chinese remedies for immunity; Xie is also the author of HRP-C (a Canadian yin-yang balancing formula). According to the Steven Horne article published by Four Winds Nutrition, Liver Balance was designed by 'a Chinese herbal doctor' (unnamed), and Horne spent three weeks in mainland China when NSP was launching its Chinese line. Steven Horne (registered herbalist, former president of the American Herbalists Guild, founder of Tree of Light Publishing) was an NSP consultant and formulator and popularized these formulas with a body-systems approach ('Builder'/'Cleanser'), in 'The Comprehensive Guide to Nature's Sunshine Products' and in the Tree of Light Chinese constitutional questionnaire; his references cite, among others, the materia medica by Bensky and Gamble and 'Oriental Materia Medica' by Hong-Yen Hsu (as bibliography, not as the author of the formulas). The formulas have Chinese names that are therapeutic principles (tiao he, bu xue, xiao dao, wen zhong, yang xin, an shen, qing re, bu yin, jian gu, qu shi, fu lei, xuan fei, jie yu, sheng mai). They are sold in a regular version (100 capsules) and as a 'TCM Concentrate' (30 capsules, concentrated extract). In Canada several carry '-C' codes (e.g. HS-C ~ Nervous Fatigue, LH-C = Lung Support, STR-C ~ Stress Relief). Documented former names: Blood Stimulator = 'Blood Build'; Breathe Activator = 'Breathe E-Z'; Stress Relief = 'STR-C'. Jake Fratkin (Chinese Herbal Patent Formulas) includes an appendix of NSP products with names such as 'Tiao He - Bupleurum and Peony 12 Combination', 'Bu Xue - Dang Gui and Peony 16 Formula' and 'Yang Xin - Biota and Zizyphus 18 Formula' (seen only in a search summary; the text could not be opened). It was not found who originally designed the element-pair scheme, nor the exact launch dates of each formula; no old NSP manuals were found on archive.org either.

formulas.accion_energetica: Earth-reducing; Chinese name 'xiao dao' = 'clear the congestion'. According to NSP it 'moves chi toward the head' and supports the elimination of excess Dampness and toxins. Horne: a cleanser ('cleansing') that expels gas and undigested food.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): the composition (agastache/huo xiang, magnolia, citrus peel, atractylodes, hoelen, ginger, licorice, platycodon, crataegus/shan zha, shen qu) resembles Huo Xiang Zheng Qi San combined with herbs from Bao He Wan (food stagnation).
patrones_mtc: Dampness in the Middle Jiao (inferred from 'elimination of excess Dampness')
sintomas: chronic worry ('Excess Earth' symptoms from the questionnaire)
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning). Because of its cleansing nature it is aimed at acute/excess conditions; for weak digestion due to deficiency, Horne recommends Spleen Activator.
formulas.descripcion_oficial: According to Chinese philosophy, this super-concentrated formula helps move extra chi toward the head and supports the natural elimination of Dampness and toxins. It is considered 'earth reducing' in Chinese herbalism; its Chinese name translates as 'clear the congestion'.
formulas.energetica_oficial: 'Earth-reducing' formula; moves chi toward the head; eliminates Dampness.
beneficios_oficiales: Supports the digestive, intestinal and urinary systems
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 capsule with a meal daily.
Take 3 veggie capsules with a meal three times daily.

formulas.accion_energetica: 'xuan fei' = 'ventilate the lungs' (ventilate/open the Lungs). Mobilizes mucus to cleanse toxins and clear debris from the Lungs; citrus and schisandra 'enhance the energy of the lungs'. A cleanser for stressed Metal.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): citrus peel, typhonium/pinellia, hoelen and licorice form the core of Er Chen Tang; perilla, apricot seed, magnolia, morus, tussilago, fritillaria and platycodon are classic herbs for descending Lung Qi and transforming Phlegm.
sintomas: feeling of fullness in the chest
excessive sadness or grief ('Excess Metal' questionnaire)
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: Its Chinese name translates as 'ventilate the lungs'. It is a formula for a stressed metal constitution. The blend aims to help the bronchioles clear debris and maintain lung health, and it stimulates mucus production to help cleanse the respiratory tract. Citrus peel and schizandra support the body's efforts to eliminate debris from the respiratory system and increase energy in the lungs.
formulas.energetica_oficial: Stressed Metal constitution; 'ventilate the lungs'. Lungs.
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 capsule daily with a meal.

formulas.elemento: Fire (stressed fire constitution); Excess Yang category
formulas.accion_energetica: 'qing re' = 'clear the heat'. Cooling; clears Heat and toxins: 'quenches the fire element and restores balance by clearing toxins' (Canadian label, which labels it a 'Yang formula'). Horne: a cleanser for acute inflammation and excess Heat.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): scute, coptis, phellodendron and gardenia make up the complete Huang Lian Jie Du Tang; lonicera, forsythia, arctium, schizonepeta, platycodon and licorice come from Yin Qiao San.
formulas.no_indicado_para: The sources do not list specific contraindications. Horne reserves it for acute Heat/inflammation; for chronic low-grade inflammation he recommends VS-C (an inference about use, not a contraindication).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: Nourishes the structural, immune and circulatory systems. Helps eliminate toxic metabolic waste. Stimulates blood flow to support waste removal and promote a sense of well-being. Contains the same herbs as IF-C in concentrated form, based on the theories of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
formulas.energetica_oficial: Calms a stressed Fire constitution; qing re = 'clear the heat'.
beneficios_oficiales: Nourishes the structural, immune and circulatory systems
May promote a sense of well-being
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 capsule with a meal daily.
Take 2 veggie capsules with a meal twice daily.

formulas.accion_energetica: 'qu shi' = 'clear the dampness' / 'eliminate moisture'. Drains Dampness and retained fluids (morus, hoelen, alisma, astragalus). Horne: 'Cleanser - for water retention where the kidneys need to be stimulated to flush fluid out'.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): hoelen, polyporus, alisma, atractylodes and cinnamon twig make up the complete Wu Ling San; with magnolia and citrus peel it resembles Wei Ling Tang; astragalus and siler evoke Fang Ji Huang Qi Tang.
sintomas: feeling of heaviness and sluggishness (especially in the afternoon)
condiciones_tradicionales: bladder infections and burning urination (listed under 'Excess Water')
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning). A distributor's product sheet warns of a possible allergy in people sensitive to psyllium. Horne notes that it may irritate inflamed kidneys (nephritis); in that case he prefers KB-C.
formulas.descripcion_oficial: Its Chinese name, qu shi, translates as 'eliminate moisture'. It provides traditional support for the urinary system and kidneys and contains herbs traditionally used to eliminate retained water. Hoelen was historically used to 'drain dampness', and alisma helps promote the flow of moisture in TCM for bladder and urinary tract support. Astragalus may help eliminate retained water from the body.
beneficios_oficiales: Traditional support for the urinary system and kidneys
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 capsule with a meal daily.
Take 1 veggie capsule with a meal daily.

nombres_anteriores: Bupleurum and Peony 12 Combination (apéndice de Fratkin, según resumen de búsqueda)
formulas.accion_energetica: 'tiao he' = 'harmonizing' (Horne: 'mediate harmony'). Cools ('cool') a stressed Liver; bupleurum is 'the most important cooling herb', which strengthens against stress by promoting the flow of chi. The basis of the Tiao He Cleanse program.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): bupleurum, scute, ginseng, typhonium/pinellia, licorice, ginger, cinnamon and peony correspond almost completely to Chai Hu Gui Zhi Tang; dang gui, atractylodes and fushen/hoelen add the core of Xiao Yao San, and zhishi that of Si Ni San.
patrones_mtc: Stressed Liver / Liver Qi stagnation (inferred from 'harmonizing' and bupleurum)
sintomas: feeling of a lump in the throat
condiciones_tradicionales: upper digestion during times of tension
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: This formula optimizes liver health while supporting the digestive and nervous systems during times of tension. It is traditionally used to support liver function, reduce stress and restore vigor, and it supports healthy digestion. The concentrated blend represents a 'wood-reducing' formula according to the philosophy of Traditional Chinese Medicine, designed to support both the digestive and nervous systems in the face of stress-related concerns.
beneficios_oficiales: Supports the digestive and nervous systems
Helps reduce stress and restore vigor

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 capsule with a meal daily.
Take 5 veggie capsules with a meal once daily.

formulas.elemento: Fire according to NSP ('fire-enhancing'); acts on the Liver (Wood) and Qi. 'Sagging Qi' category in the questionnaire (deduction).
formulas.accion_energetica: 'jie yu' = 'regulate chi' / 'relieve depression'; 'regulates and releases trapped chi'. Horne: relieves 'sagging chi' and disperses stagnant Qi; expels Wind (constriction and spasm) and Dampness (excess fluids). Discrepancy: NSP calls it 'fire-enhancing', but it is in the positive pack.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): perilla, cyperus and citrus recall Xiang Su San; bupleurum, cyperus, cnidium (chuan xiong), zhishi and citrus, Chai Hu Shu Gan San; hoelen, pinellia/typhonium, zhishi, bamboo and licorice, Wen Dan Tang.
sintomas: feeling of a lump in the throat
prolapse of the colon or uterus
condiciones_tradicionales: depression, fatigue, insomnia, neurosis, tinnitus, postpartum depression, dysmenorrhea, morning sickness, menopause, lung congestion and PMS (Chinese uses cited by Horne)
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning). Horne: if taking antidepressants, do not stop them abruptly; taper them gradually under professional supervision. It may temporarily release suppressed hostility.
formulas.descripcion_oficial: Supports mood and the nervous system; provides traditional support for the nervous system and strengthens the glandular system, which can influence mood. Supports vitality, mood and occasional sleeplessness while encouraging an overall sense of well-being. Described as a 'fire-enhancing' combination designed to regulate and 'un-trap' chi (vitality). Its Chinese name, jie yu, translates as 'relieve anxiety and tension'. According to TCM, optimal liver function supports the maintenance of mood, since the liver filters the blood that is distributed throughout the body.
formulas.energetica_oficial: 'Fire-enhancing' combination; regulates and releases chi; jie yu. Liver.
beneficios_oficiales: Supports mood and the nervous system
Encourages an overall sense of well-being
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

presentaciones.modo_de_uso: Take 1 or 2 capsules with a meal daily.
Take 1 veggie capsule with a meal daily.

nombres_anteriores: STR-C (Canadá; un distribuidor lo da como nombre anterior y Horne como fórmula 'muy similar')
formulas.accion_energetica: 'an shen' = 'to pacify the spirit' (calm the spirit). Calms with heavy substances (oyster shell, abalone shell) and nervines (polygala, jujube seed, albizzia). Horne: 'cleanser... Reducing action', activates the parasympathetic nervous system. Discrepancy: it is in the positive pack, yet an NSP product sheet marks it '(-)'.
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning). Consult a professional if taking medications (distributor product sheet).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: The formula aims to calm a stressed fire constitution and 'pacify the spirit'. It is traditionally used to nourish the nervous system and optimize gastric function, and it provides adaptogenic herbs to support the body against occasional stress. Contains the same 14 herbs as the non-concentrated version.
formulas.energetica_oficial: Calms a stressed Fire constitution; 'pacify the spirit'.
formulas.precauciones: Pregnant or nursing women should consult their healthcare professional before taking this supplement.

nombres_anteriores: Dang Gui and Peony 16 Formula (nombre en el apéndice de Fratkin, según resumen de búsqueda)
formulas.accion_energetica: Blood tonic; 'bu xue' = 'nurture the blood'. Strengthens a weakened Wood constitution; the chief tonic is ganoderma (reishi), a Shen tonic and adaptogen according to Horne.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): it contains dang gui, rehmannia and peony (the core of Si Wu Tang) plus astragalus, ginseng, ganoderma, turmeric and bupleurum; it does not correspond exactly to any classical formula.
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: This concentrated herbal blend applies the theory of Traditional Chinese Medicine to support the blood, liver, glands and circulation. The Chinese call this formula bu xue, which translates as 'nurture the blood'. It strengthens a weakened wood constitution and has 'adaptogenic' properties that normalize hormone production.
formulas.energetica_oficial: Bu xue = 'nurture the blood'; strengthens a weakened Wood constitution.
beneficios_oficiales: Supports healthy circulation and improves blood quality
Strengthens the immune system while calming nerves and muscles
Helps eliminate toxins and prevent their buildup

formulas.elemento: Water/Fire ('reduce fire and strengthen water'); Yin Deficiency category
formulas.accion_energetica: 'bu yin' = nourish/supplement Yin (Yin understood as moisture/fluid). Moistens and cools: supports the body to 'reduce fire and strengthen water'. NSP considers it 'fire-reducing'; Horne calls it a 'Balancer' that helps cells hydrate.
formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): rehmannia, cornus, moutan, alisma, hoelen, anemarrhena and phellodendron are nearly all of Zhi Bai Di Huang Wan (dioscorea is missing); trichosanthes (tian hua fen), pueraria (ge gen) and ophiopogon evoke classical formulas for 'xiao ke' (thirst and wasting).
sintomas: burning sensation in the hands and feet
condiciones_tradicionales: maintaining blood sugar levels already within the normal range
tendency toward hyperglycemia/early diabetes according to Horne
formulas.no_indicado_para: Pregnancy or breastfeeding: consult a healthcare professional before use (NSP warning). The sources give no other contraindications; because of its moistening/cooling nature it is not described for Cold or Dampness conditions (inference).
formulas.descripcion_oficial: A concentrated Chinese blend that traditionally supports blood sugar levels within the normal range. This formula helps nourish Yin or 'strengthen water'. According to TCM, the formula is called bu yin ('supplement the yin'), where Yin represents moisture. These herbs support the body in its effort to reduce fire and strengthen water.
formulas.energetica_oficial: Bu yin = 'supplement/nourish the yin' (yin = moisture); reduce Fire and strengthen Water.
beneficios_oficiales: Supports blood sugar levels within the normal range
Supports the circulatory and glandular systems
Rehmannia root helps maintain normal blood sugar

Ophiopogon supports Yin and lung function

formulas.formula_clasica_base: Compiler's observation (NSP sources do not state this): it combines herbs from Liu Wei Di Huang Wan (rehmannia, cornus, dioscorea, hoelen) with Kidney Yang tonics (eucommia, cistanche, morinda, epimedium) and bone herbs (drynaria, dipsacus, achyranthes); it is not a single classical formula.

empresa.texto: Nature's Sunshine Products was founded in 1972 in Utah (United States) by Gene and Kristine Hughes. Its first product was encapsulated cayenne pepper (capsicum): the company pioneered selling herbs in capsules. Milestones: 1974, creation of the Quality Assurance department; 1978, public listing on NASDAQ (symbol NATR); 1979-1981, start of international expansion; 1985, tripled the size of its manufacturing plant; 2015, opening of the Hughes Center for Research & Innovation; 2023-2024, plant powered by 100% solar energy and TRUE Zero-Waste Gold certification. Source: naturessunshine.com (About Us).

Nature's Sunshine sells through direct sales via independent consultants and also through its online store. It has been listed on NASDAQ under the symbol NATR since 1978. Its products are available in more than 40 countries. Source: naturessunshine.com (About Us).

The company manufactures in its own plant in Utah and states that every batch undergoes rigorous quality testing. It works with about 850 raw materials, 300 different botanicals and 170 suppliers from 30 countries. Certifications it reports: ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 17025:2017, USDA, NSF, cGMP, Kosher, TGA and Halal. Source: naturessunshine.com (About Us).

The catalog is organized by body system: Digestive System, Detox and Cleansing, Immune System, Nervous System and Stress, Glandular System, Circulatory and Cardiovascular System, Structural (bones, joints, skin, hair and nails), Urinary System, Women's Health, Men's Health, Energy and General Nutrition, and Weight Management. It includes single herbs, herbal combinations, Chinese (TCM) formulas, vitamins and minerals, enzymes, probiotics, fibers and liquids.

Nature's Sunshine products are dietary supplements. Their statements have not been evaluated by the FDA (or equivalent health authority) and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Before taking them, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding, for children, with chronic illnesses or when taking medications, a healthcare professional should be consulted. The correct dose is the one indicated on the product label for each country.
